page.overview:
Who is Adam Brashear?

Anti-Matter : Theoretically, it seems to be the main source of Blue Marvel's power. This source of power is the energy released from anti-matter which derives from the inter-dimensional universe called the Negative Zone. Anti-matter is the same as normal matter except that the sub-atomic particles are the opposite charge. Adam Brashear is the first human anti-matter generator and reactor. The experiment he gained his powers from renders his form unaffected from anti-matter.

Blue Marvel possesses vast levels of superhuman strength.

Blue Marvel flies by manipulation of gravitons, manipulation of magnetic fields, control of his absolute molecular movement, and utilizing his . Blue Marvel can fly far beyond supersonic speeds. He has been seen flying into space unaided under his own power

Anti-: Blue Marvel can absorb and generate vast amounts of anti-matter energy for various effects.
